description_text:
This model is built very near to actual scale of the real aircraft. The model has animateable features including turbines, landing gear, landing gear doors, rudder, elevators, ailerons, inboard and outboard flaps. It is fully textured with texture and livery maps and includes exterior detail. It is available in many formats.  This model is built with video animation and simulation both in mind. It can be flown or static within an animated scene around an airport or in flight. It may also be programmed for use in some flight simulation applications.
Bombardier CS-100 was developed as a member of a family of narrow body twin-engine, medium range airliners for the regional and continental markets. Originally designed and built by Bombardier of Canada it is now a joint partnership for manufacturing with France’s Airbus. The aircraft was designed for 100 to 133 seat configuration. Its first flight was in September 2013. It entered service with Swiss Global Airlines and Air Baltic in 2016. Airbus acquired a 50.1 percent ownership in the C Series of aircraft in 2018. In 2019 Airbus opened a second assembly plant in Mobile Alabama to build the Airbus 220-100 and variants.

description_text:

The model has animateable features including turbines, landing gear retraction and extension, landing gear doors, rudder, elevators, ailerons, inboard and outboard flaps. It is fully textured and includes a lot of exterior detail. This model has been improved and updated (almost completely rebuilt) to be more accurate from our early 3D model built in 2005. The Lockheed L-1011 was built to be an intermediate aircraft between the medium haul airliner and the largest heavy jet airliners. It would directly compete with the DC-10. description_text:
This model is built very near to actual scale. The model has animateable features including turbines, landing gear retraction and extension, landing gear doors, rudder, elevators, ailerons, inboard and outboard flaps. It is fully textured and includes a lot of exterior detail. This model has been improved and updated (almost completely rebuilt) to be more accurate from our early 3D model built in 2005. The L-1011 model was built with animation and videos in mind. It is also a good model to populate airport scenes as an active or static subject. It is created in Max 2014 and is available in many other formats for your immediate downloading. It could also be programmed to use in some flight simulation programs.
The Lockheed L-1011 was built to be an intermediate aircraft between the medium haul airliner and the largest heavy jet airliners. It would directly compete with the DC-10.  The L-1011 was used extensively on continental routes, and throughout the western hemisphere, Europe and Asia by hundreds of air carriers over its long career beginning in the early 1970s. However the L-1011 suffered from RR engine availability and continual maintenance problems. It did have a better safety record than the DC-10.

description_text:
This model is built very near to actual scale. The model has animateable features including turbines, landing gear retraction and extension, landing gear doors, rudder, elevators, ailerons, inboard and outboard flaps. It is fully textured and includes a lot of exterior detail. This model has been improved and updated (almost completely rebuilt) to be more accurate from our early 3D model built in 2005. The L-1011 model was built with animation and videos in mind. It is also a good model to populate airport scenes as an active or static subject. It is created in Max 2014 and is available in many other formats for your immediate downloading. It could also be programmed to use in some flight simulation programs.
The Lockheed L-1011 was built to be an intermediate aircraft between the medium haul airliner and the largest heavy jet airliners. It would directly compete with the DC-10. However the L-1011 suffered from RR engine availability and continual maintenance problems. It did have a better safety record than the DC-10.

description_text:

The model has animateable features including turbines, landing gear retraction and extension, landing gear doors, rudder, elevators, ailerons, inboard and outboard flaps. It is fully textured and includes a lot of exterior detail. This model has been improved and updated (almost completely rebuilt) to be more accurate from our early 3D model built in 2005. It is created in Max 2014 and is available in many other formats for your immediate downloading. It could also be programmed to use in some flight simulation programs.
The Lockheed L-1011 was built to be an intermediate aircraft between the medium haul airliner and the largest heavy jet airliners. It would directly compete with the DC-10. However the L-1011 suffered from RR engine availability and continual maintenance problems. It did have a better safety record than the DC-10.
